newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 321 bln lire of Italy 3-yr BTP.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 321 bln lire of Italy 3-yr BTP.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 321 billion lire of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.139 trillion lire at the open auction for the May 15, 2000 paper, against two trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.80 from 98.75 at the previous BTP sale on May 30.
